title: Matchgate circuit representation of fermionic Gaussian states: optimal preparation, approximation, and classical simulation
summary: Fermionic Gaussian states (FGSs) and the associated matchgate circuits play a central role in quantum information theory and condensed matter physics. Despite being possibly highly entangled, they can still be efficiently simulated on classical computers. We address the question of how to optimally create such states when using matchgate circuits acting on product states.
